title: ci: add change-annotator and conditional-merge-gate with dep-healer
author: Asha Patel
description:
Summary: Introduce a lightweight CI Change Annotator action that inspects diffs and annotates PRs with explicit change types (docs-only, infra, runtime, api, deps, perf). Combined with those annotations, add a conditional merge gate that wires into our GitHub Actions workflow to permit fast-path merges for docs-only and trivial cherrypick changes while requiring stage-aware presubmit runs for runtime or deps changes.

Motivation and context: We frequently see noisy full-presubmit runs for changes that do not affect runtime, or risky merges when transient devdeps are introduced by dependabot-like updates. This PR reduces feedback latency for low-risk edits and tightens policy for changes that touch critical code paths. It also adds a small "dep-healer" helper that pins transient devdeps discovered during presubmit to avoid spurious CI failures and a cache-primer script to reduce cold-run dependency install times.

What this changes: 1) .github/actions/change-annotator/ - new composite action that inspects git diff, runs a lightweight AST heuristic (for TS/Go/Python), and emits standardized labels and a machine-readable annotation used by the workflow. 2) .github/workflows/merge-guard.yml - new conditional merge gate step that consults the annotator output and toggles which presubmit lanes run. 3) ci/presubmit/stage-mapper.ts - small library to map files to presubmit stages (docs, infra, runtime, api, deps, test). 4) tools/dep-healer/ - Go binary invoked from presubmit to scan package-lock/yarn.lock/go.mod and pin ephemeral dev dependencies flagged by the annotator. 5) scripts/cache-primer.sh - primes build caches for common package managers in ephemeral CI runners to reduce median presubmit setup time. 6) refactor: move lint runners into stage-aware shards so we only execute expensive lint checks for affected stages.

Testing and rollout: Extensive local unit tests for stage-mapper and change-annotator heuristics are included. E2E smoke runs executed in a temporary branch with recorded runs (see commits). Rollout is staged: default to annotator in dry-run mode for 48 hours (action emits annotations but merge gate stays off), then enable gate for docs-only fastpath, then gradually add safe heuristics for small infra changes. Rollback is a single revert of merge-guard.yml.

Related work: Linked Linear items and earlier presubmit optimizations (ENG-2312, ENG-2400). This PR coordinates with the presubmit-cost-estimator initiative.

Checklist: - [x] Change annotator action implemented - [x] Conditional merge gate workflow added - [x] Dep-healer prototype and unit tests - [x] Stage-aware lint refactor - [x] Cache primer script and CI profiling

Notes: The annotator intentionally errs conservative for runtime changes (prefers to require full-presubmit) and has an allowlist for known docs paths to avoid false positives. The dep-healer only mutates lockfiles under a feature flag and emits a clear presubmit comment when it makes changes.

review_conversation: Jonah Kim (2026-02-11): Left a couple of nits on the annotator heuristics. Can we add a small allowlist for /docs and /examples to avoid false positives?
Asha Patel (2026-02-11): Added docs-only allowlist and updated tests to cover edge cases.
Miguel Torres (2026-02-13): Dep-healer looks good but we should not mutate lockfiles by default. Please gate the mutator behind the feature flag and emit a comment when it runs.
Asha Patel (2026-02-13): Dep-healer now runs in 'preview' mode and writes a PR comment when pin suggestions are generated. Mutating mode is behind --apply and the CI flag.

Lina Zhao (2026-02-16): Verified merge-guard behavior in staging; approved after CI flakiness check.
LGTM (approved).
release_notes: Introduce CI change annotator and conditional merge gate to speed up low-risk merges and tighten presubmit for critical changes; add dep-healer to reduce transient devdep flakiness and cache-primer to improve presubmit cold-start times.
